summary: Require a bearer token (JULES_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN) for the MCP server's --transport http listener; refuse to start it if the token env var is unset.
reason: Greptile's publish review (mvanhorn/printing-press-library PR #1794) found that the generated cmd/jules-pp-mcp/main.go dispatches MCP tool calls -- including destructive ones like sessions_delete -- using the server process's own JULES_API_KEY with no caller authentication on the HTTP transport. Any network caller able to reach the listener could invoke account-backed destructive tools. This is likely a systemic gap in every generated CLI's MCP HTTP transport template, not unique to jules; flagging via retro as well.
validated_outcome: go build succeeded; manually verified the HTTP transport refuses to start without JULES_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN set, and that requests without/with a wrong Authorization header receive 401 while the correct bearer token is accepted.
